# Mirror

Reflects one side of the frame onto the other across a vertical or horizontal line (or both, for four-way symmetry).

<EffectDemo effect="mirror" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { mirror } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/mirror';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(mirror({ preset: 'fourWay' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.axis = 'vertical'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                 | Default      | Range | Description                                                                              |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------ | ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `axis`     | 'vertical' \| 'horizontal' \| 'both' | `'vertical'` |       | The mirror line: vertical reflects left onto right, horizontal reflects top onto bottom. |
| `position` | [x, y]                               | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1 | Where the mirror lines are, in UV coordinates.                                           |
| `flip`     | boolean                              | `false`      |       | Keep the other side instead (right onto left, bottom onto top).                          |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                     |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------- |
| `fourWay`    | `axis: 'both'`                               |
| `reflection` | `axis: 'horizontal'`, `position: [0.5, 0.4]` |
| `rightHalf`  | `flip: true`                                 |
| `offCenter`  | `position: [0.35, 0.5]`                      |

Apply one with `mirror({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Distortion & warp · tracked as story X9.7 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 5.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/mirror`, including the shared effect runtime.
